segment.source: NetworkControl decides which apps may use the network. Here is how it works:
segment.target: NetworkControl 幫你決定哪些應用程式可以連網。它是這樣運作的：

segment.source: You decide when an app first connects
segment.target: 應用程式首次連網時由你決定

segment.source: A prompt shows the app and where it wants to connect. Allow or deny, and choose how long to remember the answer.
segment.target: 彈出視窗會顯示是哪個應用程式、要連到哪裡。選擇允許或拒絕，並決定記住多久。

segment.source: The overview shows connection activity over time; the Apps page lists every app that used the network.
segment.target: 總覽頁顯示連線活動的變化；應用程式頁列出所有連過網路的應用程式。

segment.source: Stay in control from the tray
Closing the window keeps protection running. Use the tray icon to switch modes or block all traffic instantly.
segment.target: 關閉視窗後防護仍在運作。透過系統匣圖示可以切換模式或一鍵斷網。

segment.source: You can change the mode at any time on the overview page or from the tray.
segment.target: 之後可以隨時在總覽頁或系統匣選單中切換模式。

segment.source: The core service is not connected yet; the mode can be chosen later on the overview page.
segment.target: 核心服務尚未連線，稍後可在總覽頁選擇模式。
